correctness.rationale: The marked increasing-tree root decomposition is exact, including exclusion of singleton child subtrees from protected roots. Differentiation gives all three initial-value formal ODEs; direct algebra proves c(z)=z b'(z)/2-z^3/[12(1-z)]. Since there are (n-1)! trees, n[z^n] extracts expectations; for n>=3 this gives Cov(L,P)=-n/12. The Bernoulli attachment variance recurrence establishes Var(L)=n/12 and the deterministic partition gives Cov(L,Q)=0. Direct exhaustive exact enumeration through n=9, 118 independently computed coefficient identities through degree 120, and boundary/nonindependence examples passed; finite tests are corroboration, not infinite proof.

value.rationale: Leaves, protected vertices, and distinct parents of leaves are canonical local-shape classes. Their exact all-size orthogonality is unexpected since the counts are not independent and are connected by a structural partition. The exact negative covariance and an explicit bivariate generating-function cancellation yield a reusable joint-moment tool, not a marginal identity or arbitrary finite slice.
